status: qualified CUDA compressor component; full attention and whole-forward admission remain open

implementation.scope: Single request, non-overlapping windows, contiguous absolute or relative staging, optional channel split for absolute output.
implementation.numerics: Original online F32 gate softmax and pooling, F32 RMS normalization and GPT-J rotation, one final F16 conversion. Separate store kernel follows all windows and retains the last min(chunk_rows, ring_rows) projected rows.
implementation.projection: Rate>1 rows<=32 uses existing source BC cuBLAS handle/workspace16MiB; longer and gateless rate1 uses existing torch-matmul handle/workspace32MiB. Existing general F16 linear API retains prior default behavior.
implementation.validation: Entire core and projected plan preflighted before projection/ring mutation. Exact typed/request-owned views, shape/capacity/alignment validation, disjoint mutable state and metadata, readonly kv==gate exact alias allowed, malformed/foreign requests rejected.
implementation.ownership: Immutable projection weights use existing backend native parameter owners. Mutable activation/ring/pool and explicit metadata views belong to caller request. No model/provider/transformer dispatch or session lifecycle changes.

source.kernel: Original non-overlap execution of dsv4_compress.cu windows/store bodies, byte-identical ported kernel bodies; unused original overlap code retained without exposing overlap execution.
source.references: Preserved original cuBLAS13.1 and paired system cuBLAS13.10 captures. Pure compression compares original projected inputs; combined operation compares paired source projections and outputs. Reference values never generated by candidate.

checkpoint.semantics: V4.1 overrides base layer_type to HCA, so these are non-overlapping rate2/rate1 compressors. Owners have idx_wk: original setup sets APE and compressor frequencies to zero, leaving normalized latents unrotated for the indexer. Source BF16 norm is converted once to explicit F16 metadata.

correctness.comparison: Byte-exact projected KV/gate, both complete rings, complete pool including untouched/stale rows, and immutable inputs/metadata. Two independent reusable requests; all guards intact; no hot resident_alloc calls.
correctness.frames: Continuous chunks [1,1,3,7,31,32,33,257,1,511], then rewind to750 for7 rows and continue at757 for33. Absolute and relative outputs for all four owners.
correctness.synthetic: 96 source fixtures x2 requests =192 calls; D32/128/512, rates1/2/7, nonzero APE/frequencies, split output, partial windows, rings/chunks >256, BC32/33 boundary, malformed capacity/alias/owner rejection and output guards.

limitations: Backend component only. Production compressor metadata setup, request cursor/history ownership, shared pool lifecycle and KV scheduling are not integrated.
Indexer key derivation/rotation, index/candidate selection, attention, F32 attention de-rotation, grouped output projection, Engram and complete model generation/CLI admission remain open.
No overlap, paged destinations, batched multi-job compression or pool quantization API yet. Relative output beyond emitted rows remains untouched and caller must track committed entries.

All actual checkpoint probes load native core+parameter owners; ASAN/UBSAN instruments probe plus selected host model/reader/layout sources. CUDA translation-unit host validation is not claimed ASAN-instrumented.
Device qualification is on selected sm_120a only. No vLLM parity, full-model throughput or all-shape/backend correctness claim.
